transcript: Mr. Warren: Not only that! I got us an AI operated security system.
Security system: A PERSON WITH A GUN DETECTED!
Mr. Warren: Excellent! Guards, get that guy and give him hell!
Mr. Warren: It's just a bag of candy!
Guard: You need more than candy to get out of this, buster!

fail_fact.title: Using AI for Security — What Could Go Wrong?
text: A student in Baltimore was walking along holding a snacks bag. AI – doing deep image analysis – decided it's not snacks, it's a gun. Police was called, and whole hell broke loose. Perhaps more scrutiny to AI implementations would be in order?
